statement: For the declared two-qubit Hamiltonian H = J Z0 Z1 + h (X0 + X1), system-bath coupling S = Z0 + 0.73 Z1, positive phenomenological rate profile Gamma(omega)=0.06 exp(-|omega|/3), and centered-window coarse-grained Kossakowski coefficients C_ww' = sqrt(Gamma(w)Gamma(w')) sinc((w-w') tau_c / 2), every tested finite-tau C matrix is positive semidefinite within numerical tolerance and the resulting channels pass trace-preservation and Choi-positive-semidefinite numerical checks. In the near-degenerate model, finite-tau cross-frequency terms produce a nonzero dynamical difference relative to the full-secular comparison generator, while at the declared very-large delta_omega*tau_c endpoint the coarse-grained generator approaches the full-secular generator within the declared tolerance.

establishes: For the declared operator/rate model and tested parameter/tau grid, every finite-time coarse-grained Kossakowski matrix is positive semidefinite within numerical tolerance.
The resulting coarse-grained channels satisfy numerical trace-preservation and Choi-positive-semidefinite checks within tolerance.
Near-degenerate Bohr-frequency cross terms can create measurable finite-tau dynamics relative to the full-secular model on the tested grid.
At the declared very large delta_omega*tau_c endpoint, the coarse-grained generator approaches the full-secular generator within the declared tolerance.
does_not_establish: That the phenomenological Gamma(omega) profile is the spectral density of any physical bath.
That this simplified C_ww' formula is a complete microscopic derivation for an arbitrary reservoir.
That finite-time coarse graining is universally more accurate than full secularization.
A Redfield solution or Redfield truth reference.
Physical hardware, biological, gravity, or clinical validity.
Correctness outside the tested system/operator/rate/tau grid.

model.hamiltonian: H = J Z0 Z1 + h (X0 + X1)

kossakowski.cp_reason: The sinc frequency kernel is a centered-window Gram kernel; numerical PSD is independently checked for every constructed C matrix.

source_binding_manifest.tau_scaling: tau_c = factor / delta_omega, where delta_omega is the minimum separation among active Bohr frequencies

interpretation_boundary.coarse_grained_model_role: CP stress-test model for secularization sensitivity
interpretation_boundary.davies_label: NOT_GRANTED: the full-secular comparison generator is not called a Davies generator because this benchmark does not bind Gamma(omega) to a microscopic weak-coupling/KMS bath derivation.
